title: I Took the Bus-Transfer Receipt to the Driver Who Punched It Used

parts.text: I boarded at 5:22 p.m. with a transfer still valid for eleven minutes. Driver Cole punched USED before the scanner sang. I was thirty-four, rider, holding the paper the machine had just issued. I photographed the punch, the time, and the unused scan. Then I asked for the fare log. Dispatch pinged why Cole's name was on a valid slip. Cole ran the next transfer through the scanner like everyone else. I kept the receipt in a folder labeled BORING. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
